claim.text: Microsoft documents VDB syntax with optional factor and no_switch arguments. Factor defaults to 2. TRUE for no_switch prevents switching; FALSE or omission permits switching to straight-line when that depreciation exceeds declining-balance depreciation. The page publishes six numerical examples but does not specify a general fractional-interval equation or detailed error rules.

source.excerpt: The Microsoft VDB page gives VDB(cost,salvage,life,start_period,end_period,[factor],[no_switch]); factor defaults to 2; TRUE prevents the straight-line switch; FALSE or omitted enables it when straight-line depreciation is greater than declining balance. It describes partial-period support and gives daily, monthly, annual, multi-month, custom-factor, and 0-to-0.875 examples. It also says all arguments except no_switch must be positive, despite the same page allowing salvage 0 and showing start_period 0.
